title: Core Mapping - Double-click to select
body:
Fixes #2810 

Hi @IanMayo, currently I think we can support click event listener because the marker does not support double click event.

issues.title: Core Mapping - Double-click to select
issues.body:
Users can use filter(s) to get to features of interest, then select them and edit their properties.

It would be useful to be able to click on a feature on the map, and it be selected in the mapping bar.
